label: Идея
description: A 10-sentence usage card for идея with evaluation, planning, and discussion language.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Basic evaluation. 1. 'Хорошая' is a common adjective that immediately adds value. 2. 'Идея' is one of the most useful abstract nouns in Russian. 3. The phrase is short and reusable.
Strategic focus: Freshness and novelty. 1. 'Новая' matches the feminine noun. 2. The phrase is useful for planning and creative thinking. 3. This is a very natural everyday pairing.
Strategic focus: Possession of thought. 1. 'У меня есть' is the standard Russian possession frame. 2. 'Идея' is the thing possessed. 3. This is a very common conversation starter.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 1. 'Об идее' shows the 'about' frame. 2. 'Думаю' makes the sentence feel active and thoughtful. 3. This is a useful pattern for reflection and planning.
Strategic focus: Comparison. 1. 'Эта' points at one specific idea. 2. 'Лучше' creates an immediate evaluation contrast. 3. The line is strong for comparison practice.
Strategic focus: Dative experiencer. 1. 'Мне' marks the person experiencing the reaction. 2. 'Нравится' is a key everyday verb. 3. The sentence is natural and highly reusable.
Strategic focus: Opposite evaluation. 1. 'Плохая' gives the direct negative contrast to 'хорошая'. 2. The phrase is compact and emotionally clear. 3. It is ideal for future binary adjective work.
Strategic focus: Linked abstract nouns. 1. The conjunction joins two planning concepts. 2. The phrase is short and memorable. 3. This is useful for thinking and decision-making language.
Strategic focus: Social use of the noun. 1. 'Обсуждаем' is a high-value conversational verb. 2. 'Идею' becomes the object under discussion. 3. This sentence is great for meetings and planning.
Strategic focus: Descriptive abstract noun. 1. 'Интересная' agrees with the feminine noun. 2. The phrase is very natural in speech. 3. It is a clean, useful model for future noun cards.
